svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean every joint with a stainless brush and solvent first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TIG weld the bars to the spine foot in a jig that holds their

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: trunk-side faces at 120 deg, bottoms level with the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm fillets all round each bar end; the bar ends must not

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand proud of the spine's front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Then the four eye rings, then the two cheeks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the V faces meet (if extended) 8 in front of the spine

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge; both bar faces flat within 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No galvanising: aluminium is left bare. Deburr the slots and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: eyes; a 7 mm bar must pass both slots, the 8 pin its hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Welds weaken 6082-T6 beside them by about half: weld only

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: where shown, and never straighten the frame by heating.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stamp SWL 100 kg ONE PERSON and the frame number on the spine.
